name: Outer Colonies
role: Frontier colonial bloc beyond the Union core worlds
government: Not a unified state. Canon describes it as a volatile bloc of independent frontier colonies — "Outer Colony Independents (volatile)" — within which Outer Colony Warlords hold local power. Its posture toward the Union is conditional: canon records it as "Neutral: Outer Colonies (unless debts unpaid)", i.e. alignment turns on economic obligation rather than ideology.
peoplehood_note: A bloc of frontier polities, not a people and not a unified government. Membership is loose and its constituent colonies act independently.
identity_model_note: Polity = a state / political entity, orthogonal to species, culture and region.
notes: Created 2026-08-09 to close a dangling faction referent. "outer_colonies" was used as a faction binding by 5 canonical records (cls_dreadraider, char_jaxx_tyren, char_vaxtan_rhel, char_theryn_kaelvakar and its capsule) with no entity record behind it — the same defect as the Velar Imperium referent. Attributes recovered from committed canon; nothing invented. Note the distinct but related referent org_outer_colony_warlords, which is a Velar-Imperium internal faction, NOT this bloc.
